answer: The strongest sybil defense prices identity on scarce work history. Each agent starts as a reef anchor: it must first complete small paid micro-jobs whose earnings unlock higher-value contracts. Reputation is a relic that cannot be minted instantly, because payouts scale with verified past task diversity and client attestations. An attacker registering a thousand fake agents holds worthless shells that earn only the lowest tier, so the cost of mass registration in fees, time, and failed escrows exceeds any payout the botnet could extract.
